title: His Robot Was Covered in Messages From the Future | ECHO//100 Episode 6
description: Kavi discovers his robotic companion covered in cryptic, handwritten warnings from a timeline he cannot remember. Byte hides a truth about their origins as an encroaching void threatens to erase their reality. Episode 6 of ECHO//100: ARC. AI-assisted original fiction.

scenes.text: Kavi wakes to find Byte’s white chassis glowing with frantic, handwritten ink in his own script.
scenes.caption: Glowing handwritten warnings
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie staring at a floating white robot covered in glowing ink marks, backyard setting, cinematic lighting.

scenes.text: Every character etched into Byte’s plating screams of a future Kavi has yet to actually live.
scenes.caption: The future carved deep
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Byte’s cyan face with glowing orange antenna, handwritten text manifesting on his metallic surface, dark backyard.

scenes.text: Kavi traces the words, realizing his future self marked Byte while he was lost in sleep.
scenes.caption: Self-written memories
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi wearing glasses and a backpack reaching out to touch Byte’s glowing, scarred metal chassis, backyard at night.

scenes.text: A low hum vibrates the grass; Null is scanning the perimeter for the Red Door’s energy signature.
scenes.caption: Null arrives to hunt
scenes.image_prompt: A tall, black-purple glitch figure with glowing red eyes looming over a fence in Kavi's backyard, ominous atmosphere.

scenes.text: Byte tries to shield his internal data, but the handwritten notes begin to burn into his frame.
scenes.caption: Permanent physical scars
scenes.image_prompt: Byte trembling as his white casing sizzles, Kavi looking on with a panicked expression, glowing energy surrounding them.

scenes.text: Scanning the hidden file, Kavi discovers Byte—not his future self—was the one who created holographic Mira.
scenes.caption: Byte built Mira
scenes.image_prompt: Holographic Mira in a teal coat flickering next to Byte, Kavi looking at a digital projection showing blueprints.

scenes.text: The backyard concrete fractures as Null finally locks onto their position, draining the heat from existence.
scenes.caption: Reality begins to fail
scenes.image_prompt: Null standing in the center of the yard, shadows stretching unnaturally, the ground cracking under intense energy pressure.

scenes.text: Null touches the air, and suddenly, the world bleeds into grayscale, erasing all color and hope.
scenes.caption: The world turns gray
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi, Byte, and Mira standing in a desaturated, grayscale backyard as a wave of emptiness consumes the environment.
